title: Morning Brief
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) in chat, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request into chat, for a deeper dive.

items.headline_md: Russian overnight strikes kill at least 15 across Ukraine
items.summary_md: Zelensky called it one of Russia's "most vile" attacks, with 70 missiles fired and a five-storey apartment block in Pryluky destroyed on Putin's 74th birthday.

items.headline_md: Tropical Storm Isaias forms and is forecast to hit the US Gulf Coast as a hurricane
items.summary_md: The National Hurricane Center says it could make landfall between eastern Louisiana and the western Florida Panhandle later this week, and would be the Atlantic season's first hurricane.

items.headline_md: Chemistry Nobel goes to Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai for explaining life's molecular 'handedness'
items.summary_md: The French and Japanese chemists showed how nature makes only one mirror-image form of molecules such as amino acids.

items.headline_md: Trump says he'll talk to Putin about a plague-lab worker's death in Siberia
items.summary_md: The US has asked Russia for more information about the death at Irkutsk's anti-plague institute, while the Kremlin says no call is scheduled and accuses media of false reporting.

items.headline_md: France suspends police stun grenades after a 15-year-old's hand was blown off at a student protest
items.summary_md: More than 500 schools were fully or partly shut on Wednesday, and Prime Minister Lecornu is due to address the protests tonight.

items.headline_md: Update: Rubio says Iran has missed 'multiple' chances for a nuclear deal
items.summary_md: Speaking in Greece, he said talks on a lasting ceasefire and peace agreement remain stalled.

items.headline_md: 30-year mortgage rate climbs to 7.49%, the highest in nearly three years
items.summary_md: Mortgage applications fell 4.2% in the week, and refinance demand dropped 8% and is down 56% from a year ago, per the Mortgage Bankers Association.

items.headline_md: Finland orders Google to halt work on two data centers
items.summary_md: Regulators paused construction at Muhos and Kajaani until environmental assessments are done, a month after Google pledged $15B for AI infrastructure there; Google says it "fell short" of its standards.

items.headline_md: Japan raids Asahi and Kirin over an alleged beer price-fixing cartel
items.summary_md: Sapporo and Suntory were reportedly searched too, and Asahi, Kirin and Sapporo shares fell on the news.

items.headline_md: House China committee says trading app Webull is structurally tied to Beijing
items.summary_md: The bipartisan report says the Florida-based platform, with 28 million users, exposes customer data to Chinese surveillance risk.

items.headline_md: McDonald's sued over an AI tool allegedly used to coordinate franchise pricing
items.summary_md: The antitrust suit, filed Oct 2 in Chicago federal court, says the tool lets independent franchisees share nonpublic price and sales data.

items.headline_md: Jaguar unveils its $130,000 Type 01 EV two years after its mocked rebrand
items.summary_md: Tata-owned Jaguar calls it the most powerful and aerodynamic Jaguar ever, as Ferrari and Bentley also push into EVs.

items.headline_md: Google launches Playground for making games from text prompts, with Unity Spark coming
items.summary_md: The browser platform lets anyone build, remix and share games by describing them; Unity's agent-based Spark tool joins in beta later this year, and both are 18+ only.

items.headline_md: Crossy Road Rush is coming Nov 5 as an Apple Arcade exclusive
items.summary_md: Hipster Whale's new entry keeps the voxel look but adds combat, exploration and up to 4-player multiplayer.

items.headline_md: SuperScale: mobile UA's top 8 networks take ~50% of spend but return only about a quarter of profit
items.summary_md: CEO Ivan Trancik, drawing on $100M+ of measured spend, argues the ~30-network long tail is where much of the profit sits.

items.headline_md: Xbox chief Asha Sharma reportedly tells staff Xbox has 'started to return to growth'
items.summary_md: She cited first-party growth and stabilized engagement after an "all-time low", without giving figures.

items.headline_md: Xbox has secured GTA 6 cloud-streaming rights
items.summary_md: They kick in in November, when Microsoft opens up access to Xbox Cloud Gaming.

items.headline_md: The New Denpa Men will shut down Dec 7
items.summary_md: Paid-item sales have already ended, and the team says it can't keep running a service that meets expectations.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still no public repo or release from u/Mindstormman's general Wii U lifter in GitHub searches this morning, and r/decomps and r/emulation couldn't be read (Reddit returned 403). No verified Switch 2 commercial-game emulation news either.

items.headline_md: Breath of the Wild runs at 4K/30 on jailbroken PS5s via the PS5CEMU-HAR emulator
items.summary_md: The homebrew app bundles Cemu (Wii U) and Azahar (3DS) on Vulkan and needs a PS5 on firmware 7.00–13.60 for the Relapse jailbreak; Wccftech notes it paints a target for Nintendo.

items.headline_md: Ship of Harkinian 9.3.0 'Dewey Alpha' ships with 500+ commits
items.summary_md: The Ocarina of Time PC port adds big randomizer shuffles, boss death skips, more cutscene skips and instant text; released Oct 5, 7:44 PM AZ.

items.headline_md: DuckStation pushes a new build fixing game release dates and save-state titles
items.summary_md: Version 0.1-12074 landed Oct 6, alongside new daily RPCS3 (USIO light-gun and RSX debugger fixes) and Xenia Edge builds.

items.headline_md: Update: Verity made $2.4M Monday (Oct 5) for a $34.4M domestic total
items.summary_md: Resident Evil is at $126.2M after 18 days, and Tom Cruise's Digger reached $8.8M in four days.

items.headline_md: Verity also opens No. 1 in the UK and Ireland with £3.3M ($4.5M)
items.summary_md: Digger opened fourth there; Sorkin's The Social Reckoning and Greengrass's The Uprising open in 300+ UK sites Friday.

items.headline_md: Eva Marie Saint, Oscar winner for On the Waterfront, dies at 102
items.summary_md: She also starred opposite Cary Grant in Hitchcock's North by Northwest, and died Tuesday at home in Los Angeles.

items.headline_md: Update: Skydance's CEOs face questions on day one after the WBD merger
items.summary_md: David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz were pressed on how a company with $79B of debt can commit $30B–$40B to new content.

items.headline_md: The Phantom of the Opera will be filmed live in London and released in cinemas in 2027
items.summary_md: Universal, LW Entertainment and Cameron Mackintosh are behind it as the show marks 40 years at His Majesty's Theatre on Oct 9.

items.headline_md: Zhang Yimou teases his Three-Body Problem film at the Busan festival opening
items.summary_md: The adaptation is produced by Nezha 2 studio Beijing Enlight Media and is understood to involve a significant AI component.

items.headline_md: OpenAI releases 722 math manuscripts it says solve hundreds of open problems
items.summary_md: The work came from an unreleased model and was published on GitHub, as mathematicians question how labs announce and credit such results.

items.headline_md: Mistral releases Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter multimodal model
items.summary_md: It's API-only for now, with open weights promised in about three weeks after safety testing; Mistral says it trained it on just 4,000 Nvidia GPUs.

items.headline_md: Meta's Muse agent is the top free iPhone app; now it has to become a habit
items.summary_md: Meta stock is up about 20% since Muse launched a month ago.

items.headline_md: Common Sense Media rates ChatGPT for Teens an 'unacceptable risk'
items.summary_md: Its assessment says the teen experience doesn't alert parents when it should.

items.headline_md: GPU cloud Lambda is raising up to $4B at a $14.5B pre-money valuation
items.summary_md: Coatue and Blackstone lead what could be its last private round before a planned 2027 IPO.

items.headline_md: San Diego County sues AppLovin over alleged ad targeting of children
items.summary_md: The suit says AppLovin bypassed parental controls and opt-outs, fingerprinted kids, and served adult ads, including one for a sexualized AI chatbot inside a physics puzzle game.

items.headline_md: EU floats an annual lump-sum digital tax that would hit Apple, Google and Meta
items.summary_md: The FT-reported compromise aims to raise revenue without provoking White House retaliation.

items.headline_md: Apple is reportedly building smart-home devices with LG, including a lock, thermostat and doorbell
items.summary_md: Bloomberg reports the partnership as part of a broader Apple smart-home push.

items.headline_md: Xreal opens Aura Android XR glasses pre-orders at $1,279
items.summary_md: That's $20 less than Meta's VR Glasses, with the first transparent Android XR glasses "weeks" away for reservation holders.

items.headline_md: Spotify expands audiobooks to more than 180 markets
items.summary_md: It's adding 350,000 titles in over 120 languages, after being mostly limited to English-speaking markets and Germany.

items.headline_md: Futures lower ahead of Fed minutes: Dow −0.76%, S&P −0.47%, Nasdaq 100 −0.79% (4:54 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: That follows record S&P 500 and Nasdaq closes Tuesday (7,818.93 and 27,599.89; Dow 51,521.28), with rebounding yields and oil weighing, per Reuters.

items.headline_md: 10-year Treasury yield back up to 5.333%, +6 bp (5:04 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Yields rebounded ahead of this afternoon's FOMC minutes.
Quotes are front-month futures (WTI November, Brent December, gold December).

items.headline_md: Bitcoin slips 2.3% to about $83,612 (5:04 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: It's down about $1,932 over the past day.

items.headline_md: Premarket movers: Neogen +11%, Penguin Solutions +4%, Flutter +3%, Constellation Brands −5% (as of 4:27 AM AZ)
items.summary_md: Neogen raised guidance, Flutter got a Citi upgrade, and Constellation fell on weaker beer margins despite a beat.

items.headline_md: Phoenix, AZ: Sunny, high near 101°F, low around 79°F tonight, 1% precip, no alerts
items.summary_md: No rain expected today or tonight, with light winds.

items.headline_md: Show Low, AZ: Sunny, high near 77°F, low around 50°F tonight, 3% precip, no alerts
items.summary_md: Mostly clear tonight, with no rain or snow expected.

items.headline_md: Snowflake, AZ: Sunny, high near 80°F, low around 50°F tonight, 2% precip, no alerts
items.summary_md: Mostly clear tonight, with no rain or snow expected.

items.headline_md: Polygon: how AI tools are fueling game mashups, PS5 emulators and jailbreaks at once
items.summary_md: It ties the PS5 emulation and recomp surge you're tracking to AI-assisted reverse engineering, and explains why Sony is suddenly in an IP fight.
